answer: The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1135 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the orchard. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the basalt queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 38 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
